title: Structured Outputs From Scratch
description: Implementing Constrained Decoding in under 300 lines
content:
If you've ever asked a LLM to output JSON, it might return markdown code blocks, hallucinate extra fields or produce invalid syntax.

Structured Outputs solve this by making invalid outputs impossible at the token level. We've got [OpenAI's Constrained Decoding](https://openai.com/index/introducing-structured-outputs-in-the-api/) and [Outlines](https://github.com/dottxt-ai/outlines) an open source equivalent that's used in libraries like vLLM to ensure function calls are parsed as intended.
